mapper.select: SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.community} x ON GROUP BY d.districtid

SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Constructed') AS constructed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Under Construction') AS under_construction, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus = 'available') AS vacant_serviced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.construction_status = 'Not Constructed' AND x.servicestatus IN ('notAvailable', 'notAvailableHaveConsNOC')) AS vacant_unserviced FROM d JOIN ${t.plot} x ON GROUP BY d.districtid
SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, coalesce(nullif(trim(x.primaryuseengdesc), ''), 'Undefined') AS use_desc, count(*) AS plot_count FROM d JOIN ${t.plot} x ON GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.physicalstatus IN ('underConstruction', 'Under Construction')) AS under_construction FROM d JOIN ${t.building} x ON GROUP BY d.districtid
SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.school} x ON GROUP BY d.districtid

SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.doh} x ON WHERE x.facility_category = 'Medical'
AND NOT (coalesce(x.facility_name_in_english, '') ILIKE ANY (ARRAY[ #{p} ]::text[]))
GROUP BY d.districtid
SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, count(*) AS n FROM d JOIN ${t.mosque} x ON GROUP BY d.districtid

SELECT d.districtid AS makani_id, x.buildingid AS building_id, round(coalesce(nullif(x.buildingheight, 0), x.buildingnumberoffloors * 3.5, 6)::numeric, 1) AS height, (x.physicalstatus IN ('underConstruction', 'Under Construction')) AS under_construction, encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Force2D(x.shape)), 'hex') AS geom_hex FROM d JOIN ${t.building} x ON WHERE x.shape IS NOT NULL
